prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: CN1CCc2c(c3ccccc3n2Cc2ccc(C(=O)NO)cc2)C1
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL1865

Assay A:
  Description: Inhibition of HDAC6 (unknown origin) using Ac-LeuGlyLy-s(Ac)-AMC as substrate preincubated for 10 mins followed by substrate addition and further incubated for 2 hrs by fluorescence microtiter plate reader assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Assay B:
  Description: Inhibition of full length human HDAC6 using FAM-labeled acetylated peptide as substrate by electrophoretic mobility shift assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "INSUFFICIENT_INFO", "confidence": 0.5, "error_class": "assay_method", "reason": "The two assays use different substrates (Ac-LeuGlyLys(Ac)-AMC fluorogenic substrate vs. FAM-labeled acetylated peptide with electrophoretic mobility shift readout), different incubation protocols, and different detection methods, which can shift IC50 values unpredictably depending on substrate Km and concentration relative to Km, making it uncertain whether results will agree within 0.3 log units or differ by more than 1.0 log unit."}

parsed.reason: The two assays use different substrates (Ac-LeuGlyLys(Ac)-AMC fluorogenic substrate vs. FAM-labeled acetylated peptide with electrophoretic mobility shift readout), different incubation protocols, and different detection methods, which can shift IC50 values unpredictably depending on substrate Km and concentration relative to Km, making it uncertain whether results will agree within 0.3 log units or differ by more than 1.0 log unit.
